title: Move and clear a word
statement: Given an alphabet, a natural number $k$ of work tapes, and source and destination tape indices among those $k$ tapes, define a $k$-tape machine that copies the word on the source tape to the destination tape and then clears the source tape. Its states track the copying phase and the subsequent clearing phase.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A source tape index among the $k$ tapes
A destination tape index among the $k$ tapes
caveat: The supplied construction identifies its components as a copy machine followed by a clear machine, but those auxiliary machines' definitions are not included.
